options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Trial keys
options.doc:
This setting will add keys to the item pool which are needed to open the teleports to each Abyss trial.
Three keys are needed to end the game.

options.name: Disable unimportant cutscenes
options.doc: Disables any story cutscenes that do not move or warp the player. Does not affect logic.
options.doc_fr: Désactive les coulisses d'histoire qui ne bougent pas ou ne faussent pas le joueur. N'affecte pas la logique.

options.name: Deathlink
options.doc:
On death a trigger to kill all other deathlink players will be sent. When another deathlink
player dies you die as well.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The Goal of the game.
[Vanilla] Reaching and beating Nonota will end the game.
[Magic Master] All attack magics (arcane, ice, fire and thunder) must be at the max set level before Nonota can be reached.
[Boss Hunt] All boss tokens gained by defeating bosses need to be collected before Nonota can be reached.
[Lore Keeper] All lore items must be collected before Nonota can be reached.

options.name: Abyss Trial Requirement
options.doc:
Requirement to open the final teleport in Abyss to reach Nonota.
[Vanilla] The three switches at the end of each trial must be destroyed.
[Randomized Item] Requires three trial clear items, which are placed in the item pool.
[Magic Master] All attack magics (arcane, ice, fire and thunder) must be at the max set level.
[Boss Hunt] All boss tokens gained by defeating bosses need to be collected.
[Lore Keeper] All lore items must be collected.

options.name: Wind Requirements
options.doc:
Double Jump logic requirements.
[Start with] Will put one copy of Wind magic in the starting inventory and thus allow double jump from the start.
[Start without] Will have all 5 Wind spells in the multiworld.
[Less wind requirements] Skips some logic requirements of Wind magic in favor of trick jumps and damage boosts.
This currently includes chests on scaffolding in Lava Ruin and Dark Tunnel, Monica Arena entrance,
the Dark Tunnel mimic room chest, and access to the knight enemy in Dawnruin Castle.
options.doc_fr:
Exigences logiques de Double Jump.
[Commencer avec] Mettra une copie de la magie du vent dans l'inventaire de départ et permettra ainsi un double saut dès le départ.
[Commencer sans] Il y aura les 5 sorts de vent dans le multimonde.
[Moins de vent requis] Cède quelques exigences logiques de la magie du vent en faveur des sauts à tour de rôle et des boosts de dommages.
Cela comprend actuellement des coffres sur échafaudage dans la Ruine de Lava et le tunnel noir, l'entrée de Monica Arena, le coffre de la chambre de la chambre du tunnel sombre et l'accès au chevalier ennemi au château Dawnruin.

options.name: Condensed Magic
options.doc:
Turns each magic type into a single item which grants up to the max magic level.
If start with arcane or absorption is enabled, those will also start at max level.
This is for players who prefer checks with higher stakes.

options.name: Randomize Boss Souls
options.doc: Bosses battles will only trigger once you get the corresponding boss soul items.
options.doc_fr: Les batailles Boss ne déclencheront qu'une fois que vous aurez les éléments d'âme de patron correspondants.

options.name: Randomize Boss Tokens
options.doc:
Boss tokens will be randomized into the item pool and can be collected from anywhere.
Only relevant for Boss Hunt goal. Does nothing for other goals.
options.doc_fr:
Les jetons Boss seront randomisés dans le pool d'articles et peuvent être collectés de n'importe où.
Seulement pertinent pour le but Boss Hunt. Ne fait rien pour d'autres buts.

options.name: Skippable Bosses
options.doc:
Boss battle triggers for Enraged Armor and Tania will be shrunk and visible to allow passing without fighting.
Specter Armor and both Vanessa fights will have alternate warp points to the next level before their arenas.
This can allow more flexibility with order of checks or affect progression order when boss souls are enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Les déclencheurs de bataille de Boss pour Enraged Armor et Tania seront rétrécis et visibles pour permettre le passage sans combat.
Specter Armor et les deux combats Vanessa auront des points de distorsion alternatifs au niveau suivant avant leurs arènes.
Cela peut permettre une plus grande flexibilité avec l'ordre des contrôles ou affecter l'ordre de progression lorsque les âmes patronnes sont activées.

options.name: Shortcut lever behaviour
options.doc:
Shortcut gate behaviour.
[Vanilla] Shortcuts are closed and will be opened when their lever is pulled.
[Always open] Shortcut gates will always be open.
[Randomized] Adds shortcut gate items to the item pool.
Pulling a lever will then reward a random item and the shortcut will only open when its item is found.

options.name: Magic puzzle gate behaviour
options.doc:
Magic puzzle gate behaviour.
[Vanilla] Magic puzzle gates are closed and will be opened when their puzzle is solved (destroy switches).
[Always open] Magic puzzle gates will always be open.
[Randomized] Adds puzzle gate items to the item pool.
Solving a puzzle will then reward a random item and the puzzle gate will only open when its item is found.

options.name: Randomize lore items
options.doc:
How Lore items (green glowing circles) will be randomized into the item pool.
[Vanilla] Lore items will all be in their vanilla locations.
[Randomized] Lore items will be randomized in the item pool, and picking them up will be a check.
[Checks Only] Lore items will be removed from the item pool, but picking them up will be a check.
[No Lore] Lore items and checks are not included in the world.
If Checks or No Lore is selected while lore keeper is set as either the goal or abyss trial requirement, it will default to "Randomized".
options.doc_fr:
Comment les objets loyaux (cercles lumineux verts) seront randomisés dans le pool d'objets.
[Vanilla] Les objets loyaux seront tous dans leurs emplacements de vanille.
[Randomisé] Les objets loyaux seront randomisés dans le pool d'objets, et les ramasser sera un chèque.
[Vérifie seulement] Les objets loyaux seront retirés de la piscine, mais les ramasser sera un chèque.
[Pas de Lore] Les objets et les vérifications ne sont pas inclus dans le monde.
Si Checks ou No Lore est sélectionné alors que le gardien de lore est défini comme l'exigence d'essai but ou abyss, il sera par défaut à "Randomized".

options.name: Wallsanity
options.doc:
Breakable walls can only be broken when a corresponding item is given.
Attempting to break a wall will also grant a check.
options.doc_fr:
Les murs brisés ne peuvent être brisés que lorsqu'un élément correspondant est indiqué.
La tentative de briser un mur permettra également de vérifier.

options.name: Jugsanity
options.doc: Breaking a jug will grant a check.
options.doc_fr: La rupture d'une cruche donnera un chèque.

options.name: Barrelsanity
options.doc: Breaking a barrel will grant a check.
options.doc_fr: La rupture d'un tonneau donnera un chèque.

options.name: Dollsanity
options.doc: Breaking a broken doll will grant a check.
options.doc_fr: La rupture d'une poupée brisée donnera un chèque.

options.name: Randomize Light Orb
options.doc: Access to using light orbs in Dark Tunnel requires an item. Does not add any locations.
options.doc_fr: L'accès à l'utilisation des orbes lumineuses dans le tunnel noir nécessite un article. N'ajoute aucun emplacement.

options.name: Randomize Crystal Balls
options.doc:
Activating crystal balls that dissipate dark fog in Dark Tunnel will grant a check.
Note that any crystal ball that opens a barrier is not included.
Disabling dark fog (non-progression) will also be added to the item pool.
options.doc_fr:
Le fait d'activer des boules de cristal qui dissipent le brouillard noir dans le tunnel noir permettra de vérifier.
Notez que toute boule de cristal qui ouvre une barrière n'est pas incluse.
La désactivation du brouillard foncé (non-progression) sera également ajoutée au pool d'articles.

options.name: Crystalsanity
options.doc: Breaking a crystal (in Spirit Realm and Abyss) will grant a check.
options.doc_fr: Briser un cristal (dans Spirit Realm et Abyss) donnera un contrôle.

options.name: Entrance randomization
options.doc: Randomizes the start level and the destinations of doors/post-cutscene level changes.

options.name: Starting Area
options.doc: Sets starting area, default is starting in Shrine

options.name: Disable Dark Tunnel thunder wall
options.doc: Disable thunder wall in Dark Tunnel, which removes the thunder requirement for passing through the stage.
options.doc_fr: Désactiver le mur de tonnerre dans le tunnel obscur, ce qui élimine l'exigence de tonnerre pour passer à travers la scène.

options.name: Disable Dark Tunnel bridge collapse
options.doc:
Disables the Dark Tunnel bridge collapse cutscene and allows two-way movement through the bridge in logic.
This can help create more interesting worlds when gate or entrance randomization is enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Désactive l'effondrement du pont du tunnel sombre et permet un déplacement bidirectionnel à travers le pont en logique.
Cela peut aider à créer des mondes plus intéressants lorsque la randomisation des portes ou des entrées est activée.

options.name: Skips in logic
options.doc:
List of in-bound and glitchless skips to be considered in logic.

Valid values: All, Underground Wind Skip, Underground Barrier Before Tania Skip,
Lava Ruins Monica Skip, Lava Ruins Platforms Skip, Dark Tunnel Hat Skip,
Spirit Realm Arcane Barrier Skip, Spirit Realm Seal Barrier Skip, Spirit Realm Elevator Skip,
Abyss Giant Maid Skip, Abyss Underground Trial Barrier Skip

options.name: Boss Requirements Difficulty
options.doc:
Logic requirements for being able to beat a boss.
[Easy] Logic expects player to have multiple magic levels and absorption to beat later bosses.
[Normal] Logic expects both magic and absorption to beat later bosses.
[Absorption Only] Logic expects player to have absorption to beat later bosses.
[No Requirements] There are no logic requirements for any boss.

options.name: Max Magic Level
options.doc:
The maximum level for each magic type. A lower number means less magic items in the pool and a less powerful Nobeta.
Magic Master goals will only require up to this max level, and condensed magic will grant up to this level as well.

options.name: Start without arcane
options.doc:
Nobeta will not be able to fire arcane magic. Only melee attack are possible until some form of magic is found.
Arcane will still show up in the UI, but it will be impossible to fire arcane shots.

options.name: No mana regeneration
options.doc:
Disables mana regeneration, meaning mana must be recovered from sources like dodges, parries, consumables, etc.
This is for players looking for more of a challenge with no effect on logic.
options.doc_fr:
Désactive la régénération du mana, c'est-à-dire que le mana doit être récupéré à partir de sources comme les dodges, les paries, les consommables, etc.
C'est pour les joueurs à la recherche de plus d'un défi sans effet sur la logique.

options.name: Start with absorption
options.doc: Nobeta will start with absorption. Optionally recommended when starting without arcane.

options.name: Soul gain base value
options.doc: Whenever the randomizer would add souls to your inventory it will at least add this amount.

options.name: Soul gain factor
options.doc:
Whenever the randomizer would add souls to your inventory it will multiply the soul gain base value with
a factor randomly chosen between 1 and the configured soul gain factor.

options.name: Filler Crystal Weight
options.doc:
Weight of a filler being a crystal item, where (weight / total weight of all filler) is the likelihood.
Can be any type (HP, Magic, Defense, Arcane, Holy) and any size.

options.name: Filler Crystal Weight
options.doc:
Weight of a filler being souls, where (weight / total weight of all filler) is the likelihood.
Can be any type (Soul Essense, HP Souls, MP Souls) and a random amount.

options.name: Trap fill percentage
options.doc: Replaces a percentage of filler items with traps.

options.name: Mana Drain trap weight
options.doc:
Weight of a trap being a Mana Drain Trap, where (weight / total weight of all traps) is the likelihood.
A mana drain trap instantly depletes all of Nobeta's mana.

options.name: Bonk trap weight
options.doc:
Weight of a trap being a Bonk Trap, where (weight / total weight of all traps) is the likelihood.
A bonk trap launches Nobeta in a random direction.
